proof_review.composition: The canonical residue-point naturality gives T.fromSpecResidueField t≫f=Spec.map r≫X.fromSpecResidueField(f t). Contravariance combines this into Spec.map(r≫a). The r≫inv r cancellation is in the correct order; residueFieldCongr_fromSpecResidueField hp.symm transports the point back to p(closedPoint K), and the canonical factorization of p gives equality with p itself.
proof_review.centre: fromSpecResidueField_apply sends the image of the unique field-spectrum point to the specified t. The result is the actual chosen point, not an existential point of the fibre.
proof_review.base: The existing equations f≫s=sT and p≫s=b compose with q≫f=p. The proof reuses the same q and imposes no independent lift choice or stronger square.
proof_review.binder_scope: The two existential lemmas explicitly include hp and hres, so the centre equality and residue-isomorphism premise remain actual inputs although their syntactic conclusions omit the construction. All other occurrences infer those same parameters from residuePointLift.
proof_review.source_order: Mathlib-only helper can be placed before project geometry; it creates no Ext02/Geometry/representability dependency. A production namespace/import cleanup, if chosen, must be separately guarded.
proof_review.remaining_scope: This closes the proposed test-dependent residue-point construction only. It does not prove a Hom smoothness criterion, obstruction-sheaf identification, global lifting over small extensions, or original OBL056.
